Applying the announce-the-ceiling half instead of the card's literal suggestion is `premise_still_valid` discipline working as designed; the card's survey line was wrong in a way only measurement could show. H22's 3-day closure horizon is bounded on both sides by measurement (floor: keep the 2-day coverage four pages delivered; ceiling: the ~347-row flood that disabled the row on the sibling install), the divisor is named honestly on the summary line (~188 updates/day vs ~11 closures/day), and the declared residual (the 3–8 day band visible to neither H22 nor H8, needing an H39-shaped count not a wider list) is the honest statement of what this does not fix. Live-fire delta (77→94 H22 rows, within 2 of the pre-code prediction; all other rows unchanged) closes the loop.

Landing: ready + auto-merge this stroke; the Fixes line retires this card on merge and `pm:dispatched` is stripped in the same sweep.
